channel.title: Alabama Political Reporter - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Alabama Political Reporter (alreporter.com)

item.title: Alabama Port Authority CEO announces executive leadership team
item.description: CEO Doug Otto unveiled a new executive leadership team Wednesday, establishing key roles to strengthen operations and drive statewide economic development.

item.title: Senate committee passes bill requiring App Store age verification
item.description: Right-wing advocacy groups and Facebook's parent company Meta were among the bill's supporters at Wednesday's hearing.

item.title: Opinion | Even Mississippi is handling gambling better
item.description: Mississippi is stealing our tourism dollars and using them to better that state, better regulate the gambling there and help address the problems.

item.title: Bill to mandate physician staffing in ERs considered at Senate Healthcare
item.description: The Senate Healthcare Policy Committee considered SB80 to require physicians in Alabama ERs, drawing physician support and rural healthcare concerns.

item.title: Lawmakers clash over English-only driver’s license testing proposal
item.description: The House Public Safety and Homeland Security Committee debated an English-only driver's test, but lawmakers questioned creating more barriers for residents.

item.title: Breast, prostate cancer screening bills advance to Alabama House for vote
item.description: House committee members unanimously approved measures designed to eliminate patients' co-pays for prostate cancer and necessary follow-up breast cancer screenings.

item.title: John Wahl raises $1M in record Alabama lieutenant governor campaign launch
item.description: John Wahl secured the largest day-one fundraising total ever reported in an Alabama lieutenant governor race, reflecting widespread support for his conservative vision.

item.title: Representatives question Ivermectin bill during health committee meeting
item.description: Legislators discussed ivermectin resistance and the “increased risk of off-label and non evidence-based use” during a public hearing on Wednesday.

item.title: Bill to allow library board member removals advances out of Senate committee
item.description: The bill allows two thirds of a library board's appointing authority to remove a member for any reason.

item.title: Bill to allow local police to be de facto ICE agents moves to House
item.description: Debate continued over whether the bill would lead law enforcement to use racial profiling to enforce immigration law.
